notes: Drop-off and pick-up are at the Franklin Hall commons atrium (601 E Kirkwood Ave). This is separate from the summer HSJI program.
name: HSJI One-Day Journalism Workshop (Journalism: Oh, the Places You Could Go!)
org: High School Journalism Institute, The Media School, Indiana University Bloomington
what_you_do: A free one-day workshop. You learn about journalism jobs and college options from pro journalists and IU students. You try out Media School rooms and tools. You also make a short podcast.
who_can_apply: Students ages 13 to 18. No experience needed.
deadline_text: Saturday, Nov. 14 at Franklin Hall on the IU Bloomington campus. The page does not show the year. Nov. 14 is a Saturday in 2026. Registration is required but no closing date is posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the registration form on the workshop page. A liability form and details are emailed before the workshop.
